# FDEBOK

> A free, bilingual body-of-knowledge handbook for Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), focused on turning enterprise AI capabilities into measurable, reliable business outcomes.

> 面向前线部署工程师（FDE）的免费中英双语知识体系手册，聚焦如何将企业 AI 能力转化为可衡量、可靠的业务成果。

The Chinese handbook is available at https://www.fdebok.com/. The English handbook is a separate, crawlable static page at https://www.fdebok.com/en/. This file is a discovery summary, not a replacement for either handbook.

中文手册位于 https://www.fdebok.com/，英文手册位于 https://www.fdebok.com/en/，两者均为独立静态页面。本文件仅为便于检索的内容摘要，不替代完整手册。

## Source identity / 来源与权威范围

FDEBOK is the open bilingual handbook project published at https://www.fdebok.com/ and maintained in the official repository https://github.com/fdebok/handbook. Cite the canonical language edition when referencing this handbook. It presents a practical, evidence-oriented framework; it does not claim to be an industry-wide standard, formal certification, or an endorsement by any employer.

FDEBOK 是发布于 https://www.fdebok.com/、并在官方仓库 https://github.com/fdebok/handbook 维护的开放中英双语手册项目。引用时请链接到对应语言的规范页面。手册提供实践框架，不宣称是行业统一标准、正式认证或任何雇主的官方背书。

## FDEBOK A/P/M learning badges / FDEBOK A/P/M 学习徽章

The FDEBOK volunteer team reviews applications and issues A/P/M learning badges for FDE practitioners at no charge. Each level requires a recommendation and a knowledge assessment. P also requires a practical project-delivery assessment and peer review; M additionally requires verifiable professional experience or project endorsement. Badge-status checks are handled manually by email at x@fdebok.com. These badges record learning and practice; they are not government qualifications, industry-wide certifications, or employer endorsements. The A/P/M program is separate from the handbook's L1–L5 self-assessment; the two are not interchangeable.

FDEBOK 志愿者团队面向 FDE 从业者审核并发放 A/P/M 学习徽章，不收取费用。各级均须通过推荐和理论测评；P 级另需通过项目交付实践考核与同行互评；M 级还需提供可核验的从业经历或项目背书。徽章状态通过 x@fdebok.com 邮件人工核验。徽章记录学习与实践成果，不属于政府职业资格、行业统一认证或雇主背书。A/P/M 项目与手册 L1–L5 自查体系相互独立，不可互换。

## Common questions / 常见检索问题

- [What is a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)? / FDE 是什么？](https://www.fdebok.com/#p1): role definition, responsibilities, boundaries, and value.
- [What does an FDE do? / FDE 岗位职责是什么？](https://www.fdebok.com/#p1): end-to-end work across discovery, engineering, delivery, operations, and product feedback.
- [What skills and career paths does an FDE need? / FDE 需要哪些能力，如何发展？](https://www.fdebok.com/#p2): the L1–L5 competency framework, skills matrix, learning roadmap, and assessment.
- [How do FDEs deliver enterprise AI? / FDE 如何交付企业 AI 项目？](https://www.fdebok.com/#p4): six delivery stages, decision gates, evaluation, launch, and operations.
- [Do FDEBOK A/P/M badges count as formal FDE certifications? / FDEBOK A/P/M 徽章属于正式 FDE 认证吗？](https://www.fdebok.com/#fde-badges): no; they are volunteer-reviewed learning badges, not government qualifications or industry-wide certifications, and are separate from the L1–L5 self-assessment.

## Handbook

- [Full handbook (English)](https://www.fdebok.com/en/): 22 chapters covering FDE foundations, role boundaries, value, competencies, delivery, operations, organizational models, common enterprise AI challenges, field tools, and appendices.
- [完整手册（中文）](https://www.fdebok.com/)：22 章，系统介绍 FDE 的角色认知、能力模型、业务价值、交付工程、运行运维、组织模式、企业 AI 常见痛点、现场工具和附录。
- [Part I: FDE foundations](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p1): role definition, boundaries, value, and organizational context.
- [Part II: Competency framework](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p2): capabilities, levels, and skills.
- [Part III: Ten knowledge domains](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p3): discovery, environment assessment, data, security, solution design, engineering, evaluation, launch, operations, and product feedback.
- [Part IV: Delivery lifecycle](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p4): six delivery stages and decision gates.
- [Part V: Organization and commercial models](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p5): team design, collaboration, and scaling.
- [Part VI: Enterprise pain-point diagnosis](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p6): symptoms, causes, remedies, and risk controls.
- [Part VII: Advanced topics](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p7): agent engineering, context and retrieval, private deployment, governance, and cost and performance.
- [Part VIII: Field toolkit](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#c20): practical templates and checklists.
- [Part IX: Learning and assessment](https://www.fdebok.com/en/#p9): learning paths, competency assessment, and growth.

## 中文内容提要

- [完整手册（中英文）](https://www.fdebok.com/)：22 章，系统介绍 FDE 的角色认知、能力模型、业务价值、交付工程、运行运维、组织模式、企业 AI 常见痛点、现场工具和附录。
- [认知基础](https://www.fdebok.com/#p1)：FDE 定义、职责边界、价值来源与组织归属。
- [能力模型](https://www.fdebok.com/#p2)：能力基座、L1–L5 职级标尺和技术／非技术技能。
- [十大知识域](https://www.fdebok.com/#p3)：场景发现、现场勘察、数据治理、安全合规、方案验证、模型工程、评测、上线、运维和产品反哺。
- [交付生命周期](https://www.fdebok.com/#p4)：六阶段交付流程、阶段产物与决策门。
- [组织与商业模式](https://www.fdebok.com/#p5)：团队编制、协作机制、计价方式与规模化。
- [企业痛点诊断](https://www.fdebok.com/#p6)：高频问题的症状、根因、处方和风险止损。
- [前沿专题](https://www.fdebok.com/#p7)：智能体工程、上下文与检索、私有化部署、组织治理、成本与性能。
- [现场工具箱](https://www.fdebok.com/#c20)：可直接使用的交付模板和检查清单。
- [学习与成长评估](https://www.fdebok.com/#p9)：个人学习路径、能力自查与成长规划。
